scripts.build: npm run build -w @p2p/contracts && npm run build -w @p2p/api && npm run build -w @p2p/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @p2p/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run format:check
scripts.seed:demo: npm run build -w @p2p/contracts && npm run build -w @p2p/api && node scripts/seed-demo.mjs
scripts.seed:wallet-demo: npm run build -w @p2p/contracts && npm run build -w @p2p/api && node scripts/seed-wallet-demo.mjs
scripts.wallet:migration:assess: npm run build -w @p2p/contracts && npm run build -w @p2p/api && node scripts/assess-wallet-migration.mjs
scripts.wallet:migration:apply: npm run build -w @p2p/contracts && npm run build -w @p2p/api && node scripts/migrate-wallets.mjs --execute
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d --wait && npm run db:init
